title: A soaked courier flags you down
text:
A JOB
A soaked courier flags you down

"Sealed parcel for Fogmouth. Don't open it, don't drop it, and don't let the Tidewardens see it. Pays ¤2,880 on delivery by night 6."

1
Take the job · 3 hold
Deliver to Fogmouth by night 6 (1 night away).
2
Decline
Smells like trouble.

title: Pell the lamplighter
text:
A FRIENDLY WORD
Pell the lamplighter

Pell lowers his pole and leans down to your skiff. "Heard something on my rounds. Tomorrow: Tidewardens raided the Glowkelp stalls at Saint Mire. Buyers will pay anything."

Pell is sure. Rumours like this land in full about 8 times in 10.
If it holds, tomorrow at Saint Mire: sell Glowkelp there. It is two nights away, so you would arrive as it fades. Either way, you will hear what really happened.
1
Continue
